headline: Explosions heard in Sirik, Hormozgan province overlooking the Strait of Hormuz
dek: 'Several explosions' heard 'a few minutes ago' in the Karpan area of Sirik, Hormozgan Province overlooking the Strait of Hormuz; IRNA: 'local sources have not yet disclosed the nature of these explosions.' Same evening UKMTO reported a tanker struck by unknown projectile 11nm off Bukha near Hormuz…
sources: IRNA (Iranian state news agency) via Gulf News live blog
fault_line: Sirik explosions + tanker hit off Bukha in one evening — coincidence, or a new Hormuz escalation step?
